expected_path.full_instruction: Click the next to your profile README.

In the "Edit" view, you'll see some pre-populated text to get you started. On line 1, delete the text that says ### Hi there and type # About me . In Markdown syntax, ### renders the plain text as a small ("third-level") heading, while ## or # renders a second- and first-level heading respectively.
Toggle to "Preview" to see how the plain text now renders. You should see the new text displayed as a much larger heading.
Toggle back to the "Edit" view.
Delete line 3 and line 16. This HTML syntax (e.g. <!-- ) is keeping the other lines hidden when you toggle to "Preview".

Toggle back to "Edit" and remove any other lines of text that you don't want displayed on your profile.
